ihram.desc: A iyakar mikat, ana yin wanka, a sanya tufafin ihrami, a yi niyya kuma a yi Talbiyya. Bayan shiga ihrami, wasu hane-hane suna farawa (kamar sa tufafin ɗinki, shafa turare, da sauransu).

tawaf.title: Dawafi (Kewaya Ka'aba)
tawaf.desc: Ana farawa daga wajen Baƙin Dutse (Hajaru'l-Aswad), a kewaya Ka'aba sau bakwai a ɓangaren hagu na agogo. A kowace zagaya, ana gaisawa da Baƙin Dutse idan zai yiwu.

sayi.title: Sa'ayi (Tsakanin Safa da Marwa)
sayi.desc: Ana farawa daga tudun Safa zuwa tudun Marwa, sannan a koma Safa, jimillar sau bakwai. Ana tunawa da neman ruwan da Hajaratu ta yi.

halq.title: Aske ko Gajarta Gashi (Halƙi-Taƙsir)
halq.desc: Maza suna askin dukan gashin kansu ko su gajarta shi; mata kuma suna yanke gwargwadon yatsa daga gashinsu. Da wannan aikin, Umra ta kammala kuma hane-hanen ihrami sun ƙare.

arafat.title: Tsayawa a Arfa (9 ga Zul-Hijja)
arafat.desc: Wannan shi ne rukunin da ya fi muhimmanci a Hajji. A rana ta 9 ga watan Zul-Hijja, ana tsayawa a Arfa daga tsakar rana har zuwa faɗuwar rana; ana ciyar da lokacin da addu'a, zikiri da tuba.

ferahlik_sikinti.title: Addu'ar Lokacin Bakin Ciki (Addu'ar Annabi Yunusa)
ferahlik_sikinti.occasion: Ana karanta ta a lokutan wahala mai tsanani, damuwa, rashin bege da baƙin ciki.

sinav_zihin.title: Addu'ar Jarrabawa, Basira da Sauƙi
sinav_zihin.occasion: Ana karanta ta kafin jarrabawa, karatu, ko fara wani aiki mai wahala na tunani.

seyyidul_istigfar.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar (Shugaban Addu'o'in Istigfari)
seyyidul_istigfar.occasion: Ana karanta ta safe da yamma domin tuba mai gaskiya da samun gafarar zunubai.

anne_baba.title: Addu'ar Iyaye da Iyali
anne_baba.occasion: Ana karanta ta domin gafara, lafiya da rahamar iyaye da iyali.

ezan_sonrasi.title: Addu'ar Bayan Kiran Sallah
ezan_sonrasi.occasion: Ana karanta ta nan take bayan kiran sallah ya ƙare; hanya ce ta samun ceton Annabi (SAW).

iftar_oruc.title: Addu'ar Sauka (Buɗin Baki)
iftar_oruc.occasion: Ana karanta ta a lokacin buɗin baki bayan kiran sallar Magariba.

morning_1.title: Addu'ar Kariya ta Safe da Yamma
morning_1.occasion: Ana karanta ta sau uku safe da yamma domin samun cikakkiyar kariya daga kowace cuta.

leaving_home.title: Addu'ar Fita daga Gida
leaving_home.occasion: Ana karanta ta lokacin fita daga gida domin kariyar Allah da shiriya.

entering_home.title: Addu'ar Shiga Gida
entering_home.occasion: Ana karanta ta lokacin shiga gida domin salama, albarka da kariya.

waking_up.title: Addu'ar Godiya Lokacin Farkawa
waking_up.occasion: Ana karanta ta lokacin farkawa domin godiya kan sabuntar rayuwa da ƙarfi.

sleeping.title: Addu'ar Kafin Barci
sleeping.occasion: Ana karanta ta lokacin kwanciya domin samun natsuwa da kariyar Allah.

sukr_hamd.title: Addu'ar Godiya da Ni'ima
sukr_hamd.occasion: Ana karanta ta lokacin samun labari mai daɗi, domin godiya kan ni'ima da ƙarin albarka.

prayer_streak_7.desc: Ka yi rikodin sallah kwanaki 7 a jere

prayer_total_100.desc: Ka yi rikodin sallah 100 gaba ɗaya

hatim_first.title: Hatimi na Farko
hatim_first.desc: Ka kammala karanta Alkur'ani gaba ɗaya

cuma_1.title: Barka da Jumma'a 🌹
cuma_1.message: Ya Allah! Ka karɓi addu'o'inmu masu kyau, Ka albarkaci Jumma'armu. Ina fatan ranar cike da lafiya, natsuwa da albarka.

cuma_2.title: Jumma'arku ta Yi Albarka ✨
cuma_2.message: Ubangijinmu Ya girmama mu tare da masoyanmu a duniya biyu. Barka da Jumma'a mai albarka da haske.

kandil_1.title: Dare mai Albarka 🌙
kandil_1.message: Falalar wannan dare mai tsarki, albarkarsa da gafararsa su kasance a kanku. Da fatan haɗuwa a cikin addu'a, barka da daren mai albarka.

ramazan_1.title: Barka da Azumin Ramadan 🕌
ramazan_1.message: Ramadan mai albarka wanda farkonsa rahama ne, tsakiyarsa gafara, ƙarshensa kuma tsira daga wuta, ya yi muku albarka.

bayram_1.title: Barka da Sallah 🌟
bayram_1.message: Ina fatan za ku kai ga sallah masu yawa cike da farin ciki, natsuwa, lafiya da ƙauna tare da masoyanku.

offsetSheet.hint: Idan akwai bambanci a lokutan, danna katin na dogon lokaci don gyara shi.
offsetSheet.title: Gyara lokacin {{prayer}}
offsetSheet.desc: Idan masallaci ko kalandarku suna nuna wani lokaci daban, ƙara ko rage mintuna. Sanarwar kiran sallah kuma za ta bi wannan.

feedback.title: Mu Ci Gaba Tare
feedback.subtitle: Rubuta shawarwarinku, buƙatunku ko wata matsala da kuka fuskanta domin mu inganta Vera.
feedback.placeholder: Rubuta ra'ayi, shawara ko matsalar da kuka fuskanta...
feedback.error: An kasa aikawa. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa bayan ɗan lokaci.
feedback.thankYouSubtitle: Ra'ayoyinku suna da matuƙar muhimmanci gare mu. Muna aiki tuƙuru domin inganta Vera.

battery.stepsXiaomi: Saituna → Manhajoji → Vera: Kunna "Autostart" sannan ka saita Adana Baturi zuwa "Babu Ƙuntatawa".
battery.stepsSamsung: Saituna → Baturi → Iyakokin amfani na baya: Ƙara Vera zuwa "Manhajojin da Ba Sa Barci".
battery.stepsOppo: Saituna → Baturi → Vera: Kunna "Ba da Izinin Aiki na Baya" da "Autostart".
battery.stepsOther: Kashe Adana Baturi don Vera don kiran sallah ya yi sauti a kan lokaci ba tare da jinkiri ba.
battery.cardTitle: A ji kiran sallah a kan lokaci

widget.guideDesc: Danna Babban Allonka na dogon lokaci > Danna "Widgets" > Nemo widget ɗin "VERA" ka ja shi zuwa allonka.
widget.promptDesc: Ku ga lokacin sallah na gaba da mintunan da suka rage kai tsaye a babban allon wayarku, ba tare da buɗe manhajar ba.

greetingNotif.fridayBody: Aika katin gaisuwar Jumma'a ga masoyanku.

errorBoundary.title: Wani abu ya faru ba daidai ba
errorBoundary.subtitle: Manhajar ta gamu da kuskuren da ba a zata ba. Danna maɓallin da ke ƙasa don sake gwadawa.
errorBoundary.clearAndRetry: Share bayanan da aka adana kuma sake gwadawa

community.emptyWeek: Babu rubutu a cikin kwanaki 7 da suka gabata.
community.loadFailed: Ba a iya ɗora shafin ba. Ja ƙasa don sake gwadawa.

share.title: Kana son raba wannan da al'ummar Vera?
share.note: Wannan rubutu kaɗai ake rabawa. Sunanka da bayananka na sirri ba za su bayyana ba.
share.failed: Ba a iya rabawa ba. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
share.heading: Raba da al'umma
share.celebrateHint: Raba ba tare da bayyana sunanka ba da al'ummar Vera.
share.intro: 'Yan'uwa maza da mata a duniya za su iya ganin wannan. Sunanka ba zai bayyana ba.

settings.title: Saitunan al'umma
settings.participateHint: Idan an kashe, babu tayin rabawa da zai bayyana. Har yanzu za ka iya karanta shafin.
settings.showCountryHint: Idan an kunna, sunan ƙasarka zai bayyana kusa da rubutunka. Kashewa yana shafar sababbin rubutu kawai.
settings.countryInvalid: Shigar da lambar ƙasa mai haruffa biyu, misali TR
settings.deleteBody: Za a cire shi daga shafin ga kowa.

report.failed: Ba a iya aika rahoton ba.

discovery.title: Raba nasarorinka da al'ummar Vera
discovery.body: Raba hatim, zikiri da ranakun sallah ba tare da bayyana sunanka ba ga 'yan'uwa a faɗin duniya.

howTo.title: Yadda rabawa ke aiki
howTo.intro: Raba ibadar da ka kammala da al'ummar Vera. Sunanka zai kasance a ɓoye.
howTo.step1Body: Ka kammala sallolinka biyar, hatim ko burin zikiri a cikin manhajar.
howTo.step2Body: Idan bikin murna ya bayyana, danna Raba. Kana iya amfani da maɓallin raba a shafukan sallah da zikiri.
howTo.step3Body: Kowa zai iya ganinsa, tare da ƙasarka kawai idan ka yarda. Ka goge shi a kowane lokaci daga Rubuce-rubucena.

reminder.title: Raba ibadar yau
reminder.body: Kana son raba ibadar yau da al'umma?
reminder.bodyAll: Ka kammala sallolin nan biyar yau. Kana son raba wa al'umma?

vera.label: Vera
vera.m0: Burin yau: hatima ɗaya. Mu karanta shafuka kaɗan a kowace rana mu kammala Alƙur'ani tare.
vera.m1: Burin yau: bayan Isha'i, Subhanallah 33, Alhamdulillah 33 da Allahu Akbar 33.
vera.m2: Yau, mu yi niyyar yin sallolin nan biyar a kan lokaci, tare.
vera.m3: Burin yau: karanta shafi ɗaya na Alƙur'ani. Ƙananan matakai ma suna da daraja.
vera.m4: Burin yau: Subhanallah 100. Ka raba wa al'umma idan ka gama.
vera.m5: A wannan mako, rubuta jerin addu'o'i ka tuna da ɗan'uwa ko 'yar'uwa a ciki.
vera.m6: Yau, yi tunanin yin sadaka ko wani aikin alheri ga wani.

ummah.title: Al'umma
ummah.body: Raba ibadar da ka kammala da al'umma, ko duba abin da wasu suka raba yau.

qibla.title: Kompas ɗin Qibla
qibla.body: Riƙe wayarka a kwance ka juya har kibiya ta nuna Ka'aba.

silentMode.title: Yanayin shiru
silentMode.body: Idan wayarka tana shiru ko kan girgiza, ana sanar da kiran sallah a hankali. Za ka iya canza wannan a Saituna.
